existing_ledger_row.notes: The last handle's release drops the Rust object (C++ `delete this`); a Drop impl of the class is the virtual Delete override. Reference counts, null state, identity and destructions after every step are compared with OCCT by the runtime_handle_script probe.

reason: Native virtual Delete may retain a constructed zero-count object independently of its destructor. Rust Handle::drop only decrements the embedded count; eventual Arc destruction invokes Rust Drop and has no native virtual Delete override dispatch.
